# public/vendor/agents.md

Vendored third-party libraries served as static assets from the frontend.

## Files
- **`transformers.bundle.min.js`** — Hugging Face Transformers.js **v4.2.0**, **SELF-CONTAINED** minified browser ESM build (onnxruntime inlined, ZERO bare module specifiers). Used for client-side ML inference (the on-device NER PII detector, `src/lib/nerPiiDetector.ts`). Loaded at runtime via NATIVE browser dynamic import from the app origin (`/vendor/...`), not bundled by Vite.
  - **WEBEXT-01 F-1 (2026-07-06, PR #1409 §6):** the previously vendored `transformers.web.min.js` (the package's `.web.` build) carried TOP-LEVEL BARE SPECIFIERS (`onnxruntime-web/webgpu`, `onnxruntime-common`) — a native browser import cannot link those without an import map, so module linking threw on EVERY load and NER was dead-on-arrival in prod (fail-closed held; the feature was broken). NEVER re-vendor the `.web.` build here; only a self-contained build passes the gates.
  - **Source:** byte-for-byte copy of `node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/dist/transformers.min.js` (the package's standalone browser bundle) from the pinned `@huggingface/transformers@4.2.0` dependency, vendored + SHA-256-verified by `scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.ts` against `scripts/ner-runtime.lock.json`. NOT pulled from a CDN / floating `latest`.
  - **License:** Apache-2.0 (`@huggingface/transformers`).
  - **Version pin (SCRUM-2503):** this version MUST match `transformersJsVersion` in `scripts/ner-weights.lock.json` + `scripts/ner-runtime.lock.json` and `TRANSFORMERS_JS_VERSION` in `src/lib/nerPiiDetector.ts` — the SHA-256 integrity lock was built for the exact model file set THIS version requests for `Xenova/bert-base-NER` q8. The regression tests `scripts/vendor-transformers-version.test.ts` + `scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.test.ts` fail the build on any skew, and `scripts/ci/check-csp-runtime-deps.ts` fails the build if the bundle contains bare/off-origin module specifiers.
- **`ort/`** — onnxruntime WASM artifacts (`ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.{wasm,mjs}` — the flavor the pinned 4.2.0 bundle requests). **git-ignored; re-vendored each build** by `scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.ts` (`npm run prebuild`) from the exact `onnxruntime-web` version `@huggingface/transformers@4.2.0` pins, hash-locked in `scripts/ner-runtime.lock.json`.
  - **WEBEXT-01 F-2:** when `wasmPaths` is unset, onnxruntime-web defaults to a jsdelivr CDN URL the deployed CSP (`connect-src 'self'`) blocks. `src/lib/nerPiiDetector.ts` pins `env.backends.onnx.wasm.wasmPaths = '/vendor/ort/'` BEFORE any session creation (CI-enforced by `checkOrtWasmPathsPinned` in `scripts/ci/check-csp-runtime-deps.ts`). Served under `connect-src 'self'` (wasm fetch) + `script-src 'self'` (mjs factory) + `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` (instantiation). MIT license (`onnxruntime-web`).
- **`tesseract/`** — Self-hosted Tesseract.js v7 OCR runtime (WEBEXT-02 / SCRUM-2504). Served under CSP `'self'`; the npm-default `cdn.jsdelivr.net` load is forbidden by the deployed CSP (`vercel.json`). Pinned via `TESSERACT_VENDOR_PATHS` in `src/lib/ocrWorker.ts`. Lazy-loaded on first image OCR; NOT in the JS bundle. Apache-2.0.
  - `tesseract/worker.min.js` — the Tesseract Web Worker (`worker-src 'self'`).
  - `tesseract/core/tesseract-core-{,simd-,relaxedsimd-}lstm.wasm.js` — LSTM core loaders with the wasm embedded as base64 (no separate `.wasm` fetch). Tesseract auto-selects the SIMD/relaxedSIMD/plain variant at runtime by feature detection (`script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'`).
  - `tesseract/lang/eng.traineddata.gz` — English LSTM model (`@tesseract.js-data/eng` `4.0.0_best_int`), fetched via `langPath` (`connect-src 'self'`).

## Conventions
- Vendor files are checked in as-is; do not modify. (`ort/` is the exception: git-ignored, rebuilt each prebuild, hash-locked.)
- Updates require re-vendoring the EXACT pinned version (via `npx tsx scripts/vendor-ner-runtime.ts --update-lock` after bumping the dependency pin in `package.json`) and verifying the license (Apache 2.0 for Transformers.js + Tesseract.js, MIT for onnxruntime-web). For `transformers.bundle.min.js`, re-confirm `TRANSFORMERS_JS_VERSION` + `ner-weights.lock.json` + `ner-runtime.lock.json` all agree, re-run the WEBEXT-01 browser-real probe (real in-browser model load + inference under the byte-exact deployed CSP — asset availability alone proved nothing in the F-1 incident), then re-soak — PII-detection behavior may change.
- Client-side processing boundary (Constitution 1.6): documents never leave the user's device.
- Off-origin runtime fetches are CI-gated: `scripts/ci/check-csp-runtime-deps.ts` (WEBEXT-04) fails the build if a runtime dep references a forbidden CDN host instead of `/vendor`. Keep new on-device runtimes self-hosted here.
